description: This file defines the TranslatableInterface in Drupal, specifying methods for handling translations of data objects, including language retrieval, translation management, and translation support status.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the translation language as a LanguageInterface object.

methods.name: isDefaultTranslation
methods.description: Checks if the current translation is the default one.

methods.name: isNewTranslation
methods.description: Checks if the translation is new.

methods.name: getTranslationLanguages
methods.description: Returns an array of language objects the data is translated to, optionally including the default language.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a translation of the data for a specified language code.

methods.name: getUntranslated
methods.description: Returns the original language object of the translatable data.

methods.name: hasTranslation
methods.description: Checks if a translation exists for a given language code.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Adds a new translation to the translatable object.

methods.name: removeTranslation
methods.description: Removes the translation for a specified language code.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Returns whether the object supports translation.
